notes: Enable when Coinglass MCP or API is connected. Applies to tokens with CEX perp listings only.

signals.rule: Perp OI +15% 24h AND on-chain net-buy positive → +10 MES (squeeze candidate)
Funding < -0.05% AND retail bucket net-buy → +10 MES (crowded short)
OI -20% AND net sell day → -15 MES (long flush, avoid)
